propositions: The completion verifier performs 84-158 agentic tool requests per run dominated by repeated file reads due to missing file contents in the initial context, with 67-82% of distinct reads already declared in ticket file_impact.

Pre-fetching file_impact contents and referencing-commit diffs into a labelled, bounded prefetch section at assembly time reduces verifier request count by ≥20% versus baseline while maintaining equivalent verdict class.

The close gate (graph=False) prefetches only the closing ticket's own file_impact; the graph=True deep-review path prefetches the subtree-union ranked by cross-descendant frequency, with both bounded by a 30k-token aggregate cap and skeleton-compressed on size before dropping lowest-ranked files.

The prefetch section is opt-in via an explicit prefetch parameter to assemble_context (default None), preserving byte-identical output for shared callers (_review_ticket_impl, review_workflows) while enabling the completion gate to inject the bounded prefetch via cache-read under the existing automatic message-tail prefix cache.

The trusted confirm-against-working-tree and re-read-skeleton guidance is placed in the static system-prompt prefix (completion_verifier.md and _EVIDENCE_SYSTEM before the volatile marker) so both primary and successor verifier runs inherit the same rule from a single co-located source.

Recovery successors receive the prefetch automatically via the shared assembled ticket_context; prefetch bytes are counted against physical_context_ceiling so an oversize prefetch is trimmed rather than exceeding hard context bounds.
